arguments.text: Milestone complete: implemented and verified Stage 2 source comparison in work.py; report.json matches evaluating every current request against current evidence.json and policy.json. Checks covered missing conditions, no evidence, verification/withdrawal filters, canonical agreement and conflict, supersession, Boolean false, exact output fields, and input immutability. Unresolved: malformed or non-JSON-shaped inputs are outside the specified contract; no repository-provided test suite exists.
